messages:
Anya: quick a11y check on the control flyout before release. main issues: focus ring gets cut when flyout opens, placeholder cell text contrast low in compact view, and toasts aren't announced on VoiceOver.

Kai: saw the clipped focus — container has overflow:hidden. simple fix: move focusable handle outside the overflow region or use box-shadow for focus instead of outline.

Jordan: for toasts, add role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true". also ensure we don't mount them inside aria-hidden wrappers.

Dee (QA): repro steps for VoiceOver: trigger save -> toast appears but not announced. After adding role/status it reads correctly. Filed firefox focus clipping ticket — behaves differently there.

Anya: thanks. next steps: Kai will try box-shadow approach + dark/light token values, Jordan will update toast semantics, Dee will verify across VoiceOver/NVDA. aria-bot: remember contrast thresholds and focus visibility.

aria-bot: Reminder: contrast >= 4.5:1 for text, non-text UI >= 3:1, focus indicator must be visible and not rely on color alone.

Anya: tagging this a11y-blocker for the release until QA confirms.
_meta: generated for dataset: short a11y sweep - flyout focus, toasts, placeholder contrast
